question: Do source-specified word/separator key schedules yield a complete English-like LP2 page?

methods.FH1: Three separator sets (-, -., -./) advance without output; prime, prime-minus-one, totient and DIVINITY page-local subtractive streams. Original program includes 57 source pages, report unsolved subset separately.
methods.FH3: Four reset delimiter sets: word -, clause ., line /, segment &$; DIVINITY, prime or prime-minus-one stream restart at each selected boundary; source builds 300 stream values and cycles at position300.
methods.W1: Word j subtracts/adds previous ciphertext-word GP-prime sum mod29; k0=0.
methods.W2: Word j subtracts/adds previous decoded-word GP-prime sum mod29; k0=0.
methods.W3: Word j subtracts/adds cumulative preceding ciphertext-word prime sums mod29; k0=0.
methods.W4: Word j subtracts/adds Euler totient of previous ciphertext-word GP-prime sum mod29; k0=0.
methods.W5: Per-rune source control k_i=GP-prime(c_{i-1}) mod29, previous c index seed0. All W variants test both signs and both Atbash states.

overlap: FH2 first-rune shifts are subset of published full-page affine keys; reproduce archived FH2 summary for source parity only, not count as a distinct search. FH4 never ran. Published grouped-key-advance-openings uses fixed rune group lengths, not visible punctuation; published cumulative-autokey-literal has rune-level cumulative feedback, not these GP-prime word sums.
scope: 55 source unsolved rune-bearing segments from krisyotam (LP2-00..49,51..55); source known tail LP2-56/57 retained only for source parity/controls. Pages split at %, words in source W script at every non-rune, not only hyphen. Headings included.
positive_controls: The archived FH3 AN END opening is checked against the entire known reading, not accepted because of its short preview; if incomplete, the original negative is labelled underpowered.
For FH1 and FH3, plant a transformed LP2-57 Parable text under a fixed source key schedule with punctuation preserved and require exact complete recovery and score above -5.
For each W1..W5, plant GP29 ciphertext from the LP2-57 Parable with source word boundaries, seed0, sign−, no Atbash; require exact complete recovery and score above -5.

null_control.rng: Python 3.12 random.Random; shuffle all rune positions within each source page, preserve every separator position and source page boundary; repeat complete FH1/FH3/W grids and retain branch-wise and global maxima.

limits: Exact listed schedules, page-local seed0 and source quadgram model only. A failed known-page gate weakens source threshold interpretation, even when a synthetic plant passes. The added whole-search shuffle is not the original source experiment or a cipher model.
